body: Fierce emotional autonomy: you refuse to be smothered or to nurture on demand.
business: Owned, this protects your inner world and your right to your own feelings.
shadow: Suppressed it becomes martyred caretaking; unchecked, emotional walls and coldness.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
